title: Variable Flächenmodule
slide_intent: Add a surface only when it helps content separate from an image so flexibility serves readability.
strategic_value: Variable modules can let DB retain consistent elements across image-led and quieter communication.
demonstration: Four diagrams compare full-image use, an inset dark module, a partial white module and an image placed on a white ground.
practical_value: Choose between direct image placement, a content panel or an image panel according to legibility and communicative emphasis.

content_islands.name: Module rationale
content_islands.spec: Place the readability and flexibility explanation above the diagrams.

content_islands.name: Layout options
content_islands.spec: Arrange the four labeled module strategies in a two-by-two grid.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source introduces modules when content is not sufficiently readable over an image.
reference_purposes.Application: Four examples demonstrate alternative image/text surface relationships.

ingredient.name: Variable layout surfaces
ingredient.role: Separate text and image when readability needs support.
ingredient.application: Adapt module size to content, or place the image in a module on a white background.
ingredient.scope: Official DB new-design website captured 2026-11-05; edition date unstated. Modules are a response to context and legibility, not mandatory in every layout.
